faqs.question: How do I know this screen fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This listing is matched to the Lenovo ThinkPad T480. If you're unsure of your laptop's exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Do you install the screen, or is it self-fit?
faqs.answer: We can install it for you in Nairobi, or ship it with fitting instructions if you're upcountry or prefer your own technician.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this screen?
faqs.answer: This screen carries a 3-month warranty against dead pixels and panel defects from the date of purchase.
